events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born in Weston-super-Mare in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' groundbreaking album that showcased their evolving sound and songwriting brilliance.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the music world mourned the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a musical icon. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring impact on music and peace.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The innovative and influential English singer-songwriter David Bowie was born on this day in 1947 in Brixton, London.

angles.name: Bowie's Milestone
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman, David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. His incredible artistry continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still the King of Rock and Roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page was born on this day in 1944 in Heston, Middlesex.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and a true guitar innovator.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, was born on this day in 1945 in Highgate, London.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! Raise a glass to a rock and roll icon with a career spanning decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of the British band Madness, was born on this day in 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic hits.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer Paul Young, known for 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', was born on this day in 1956 in Luton.

angles.name: 80s Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul legend, Paul Young! Still got that smooth voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary American country music singer-songwriter Dolly Parton was born on this day in 1946 in Tennessee.

angles.name: Celebrating Dolly
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The lead singer of Take That, Gary Barlow, was born on this day in 1971 in Frodsham, Cheshire.

angles.name: Take That Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and a true British pop icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B and pop hits, was born on this day in 1950 in Fyzabad, Trinidad.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams, get into our cars, and turn up his hits!

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on this day in 1989, honouring rock's founding legends.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Who was in that legendary inaugural class?
